integrity: Public scientific provenance is limited to cited literature and reproducible exact checks; no independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations and nonwrapping three-consecutive-entry indicators only; finite exact second-order moments, with no Ewens or higher-order extension. Full text of Gessel--Reutenauer (1993) was not inspected; broader implicit coverage remains possible. Finite enumeration corroborates but does not prove unbounded assertions.
title: The position-resolved six-pattern cycle-covariance law for uniform permutations
